description: This file contains implementation of JSON handling classes and functions within the WPEFramework Core JSON namespace, including error message formatting, static tag definitions, and debug string generation for variants and variant containers.

classes.name: IElement
classes.description: Interface class for JSON elements, providing static tag definitions for null, true, and false.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Represents a JSON variant value with debugging capabilities.

classes.name: VariantContainer
classes.description: Container for multiple Variants with debugging string generation.

methods.name: ErrorDisplayMessage
methods.description: Formats an error message with context and position information.

methods.name: Variant::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a formatted debug string representing the Variant's value.

methods.name: VariantContainer::GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a concatenated debug string for all Variants in the container.
